title: Issue a commercial registration (establishment)
conditions: Through the Saudi Business Center; the owner must not hold another active sole-proprietorship registration; fees paid by SADAD or card. After issuance, registration is automatic with the Ministry of Human Resources, ZATCA, GOSI, Saudi Post (national address) and the Chamber of Commerce.

title: Issuing a commercial license
conditions: Electronic only. Attachments: photo of the shop front, lease contract, title deed or investment contract, sanitation contract (optional), safety equipment invoice or safety report from the Civil Defense, copy of the building permit. Issued together with the Civil Defense safety permit. 1 to 10 days; fees apply.

title: Issuing a fast-track commercial license
conditions: Commercial license with a safety permit for some activities; log in as owner or establishment manager when linked to a commercial register. 1 to 10 days.

title: Renewing a commercial license
conditions: Not possible if the commercial registration has expired. Needs the lease, deed or investment contract and a safety equipment certificate or accredited technical report.

title: Issuing a building permit
conditions: Building or fencing permit applied for through an engineering office; permit details sent to the electricity and water companies, Civil Defense, the insurer and the real estate registry.

title: Issuance of a building occupancy and compliance certificate
conditions: The compliance certificate is valid three years and issued with the occupancy certificate; no municipal fees.

title: Issuance of a health certificate for food workers
conditions: For workers in food and public-health establishments (restaurants, barbershops, laundries). Medical examination at a Ministry of Health approved centre; valid one year. 4 to 10 days.

title: Renewal of a health certificate
conditions: Verification of the business license and of the worker's profession, medical examination, health education programme if applicable.

title: Issuance of a seasonal health certificate
conditions: Seasonal variant of the worker health certificate.

title: Permit for 24-hour commercial activities
conditions: Linked to the commercial license and cancelled with it; renewable when 30 days or fewer remain.

title: Issuing a home delivery permit
conditions: For licensed commercial entities.

title: Safety license (Salama portal)
conditions: Requirements vary with the classification and size of the business; applications on the Salama portal.

title: VAT registration for businesses
conditions: For companies with an economic activity subject to VAT; a VAT account number is assigned upon registration.

title: VAT registration for individuals
conditions: Individuals engaged in economic activity; mandatory above SAR 375,000 of annual revenue, optional between 187,500 and 375,000. 5 working days.

title: VAT registration for a group
conditions: Two or more legal persons registered as one VAT group. 3 working days.

title: Zakat and income tax registration
conditions: After registration with the Ministry of Commerce; the TIN is generated automatically when the commercial registration is issued.

title: Verify VAT registration
conditions: By VAT account number, commercial registration number or VAT certificate number; instant.

title: Update VAT registration details
conditions: Amendments to registration details including financial details, with supporting documents. 3 working days.

title: Register a new establishment or branch in GOSI
conditions: After registration the establishment can obtain the GOSI certificate proving its registration.

org: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development
title: Visa issuance for an establishment
conditions: Valid commercial register (except activities that do not need one), existing establishment, wage-protection compliance, allowed activity; payment.

org: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development
title: Employee transfer from another employer
conditions: Through Qiwa; valid commercial register; employment contract for each worker.

title: Renewal of residence permit (Iqama)
conditions: Through Absher or Muqeem; valid passport, fees paid, medical insurance; fines start three days after expiry.

title: Extension of an exit and re-entry visa
conditions: Through Absher or Muqeem, including for residents outside the Kingdom.

title: Final exit visa
conditions: The residence permit must be valid at least 30 days; the visa lasts at most 60 days.
